title: Wish & If Only
summary: Use 'wish' and 'if only' to express regret, desire for change, or annoyance.

theory.markdown:
**Wish / If only** express that we want reality to be different.

**1. Unreal present or future** -> **wish + Past Simple**
*I wish I had a bigger flat.* (I don't have one — I want it to be different)
*If only she were here now.* (She isn't here)

**2. Regret about the past** -> **wish + Past Perfect**
*I wish I hadn't said that.* (I said it and I regret it)
*If only I had listened to her.*

**3. Annoyance about present/future (other person's behaviour)** -> **wish + would**
*I wish he would stop making noise.* (annoyed at his current behaviour)
*If only it would stop raining.*

Don't confuse:
- *I wish I **were** rich.* (unreal present) <- 'were' not 'was' in formal use
- *I wish I **had been** there.* (past regret)

theory.title: Wish / If only — three patterns
rows: I wish I had studied harder.
I wish you would listen to me!

items.source: If only we had left earlier — we wouldn't be stuck in traffic.
items.translation: Gdybysmy tylko wyszli wczesniej — nie utknelibysmy w korku.

items.source: I wish the weather would improve.
She wishes she hadn't told him the secret.

exercises.prompt: I wish I ___ (know) how to drive.
exercises.hint: Unreal present situation -> wish + Past Simple.

exercises.prompt: She wishes she ___ the job offer last year.
exercises.explanation: Regret about past -> wish + Past Perfect.

answers: I wish I had taken an umbrella.
I wish I had brought an umbrella.

exercises.prompt: I wish you ___ (would / stop) interrupting me!
exercises.hint: Annoyance about someone's repeated behaviour -> wish + would.

exercises.sentence: I wish I would have more free time.
answers: I wish I had more free time.
exercises.explanation: Unreal present -> wish + Past Simple (not 'would have').

exercises.source: I wish I hadn't sent that email.
answers: If only I hadn't sent that email.

exercises.prompt: I wish it ___ raining! We can't go out.
exercises.explanation: Annoyance about current situation -> wish + would + base verb.

exercises.prompt: If only I ___ (be) taller — I could reach the shelf!
exercises.hint: Unreal present: wish/if only + Past Simple. 'Were' preferred in formal use.

exercises.sentence: I wish I didn't eat all that food last night.
answers: I wish I hadn't eaten all that food last night.
exercises.explanation: Regret about the past -> wish + Past Perfect (hadn't eaten).

answers: I wish I could speak Japanese.
If only I could speak Japanese.

exercises.prompt: She wishes she ___ (not / say) those hurtful words.
exercises.hint: Past regret -> wish + Past Perfect negative.

exercises.prompt: I wish my neighbours ___ loud music so late at night.
exercises.explanation: Annoyance about someone's current/repeated behaviour -> wish + would + negative.

exercises.source: I regret not studying harder at school.
answers: I wish I had studied harder at school.

exercises.source: Zaluje, ze nie spotkalem go, kiedy mial czas.
answers: I wish I had met him when he had time.
I wish I had met him when he was free.
